sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX a 15.52 (sotto 18) indica un mercato difensivo limitato, mentre l'S&P 500 è salito del +0.66% e il DXY è quasi stabile (+0.01%). Il Brent in rialzo (+0.41%) e le azioni europee (STOXX 600 +0.77%, FTSE MIB +0.66%) confermano un bias positivo. Tuttavia la guerra in corso in Medio Oriente aggiunge un punto di pressione bearish, portando lo score a 4.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 15.52 (below 18) signals limited defensive pressure, while the S&P 500 rose +0.66% and the DXY is flat (+0.01%). Brent up (+0.41%) and European equities (STOXX 600 +0.77%, FTSE MIB +0.66%) reinforce a positive bias. Ongoing Middle East war adds a bearish point, resulting in a score of 4.

market_impact_summary.it: Equities globali mostrano slancio: S&P 500 +0.66%, STOXX 600 +0.77% e FTSE MIB +0.66%. Il Brent sale a $100.73 (+0.41%) sostenendo il settore energetico, mentre l'oro scende a $4,148.30 (-0.20%) e il TLT 20Y perde -0.48%, segnale di pressione sui titoli a lungo termine. Il DXY rimane stabile a 102.18 (+0.01%), limitando l'effetto bearish sui risk assets.
market_impact_summary.en: Global equities are upbeat: S&P 500 +0.66%, STOXX 600 +0.77% and FTSE MIB +0.66%. Brent climbs to $100.73 (+0.41%) supporting energy, while gold dips to $4,148.30 (-0.20%) and the 20Y TLT falls -0.48%, indicating pressure on long bonds. The DXY stays flat at 102.18 (+0.01%), curbing bearish pressure on risk assets.
